logline: 호랑이를 피해 나무 위로 오른 오누이가 하늘에서 내려온 동아줄을 잡는다.
destination: 우물가 큰 나무 꼭대기 — 하늘로 이어지는 자리
protagonist: 무명 저고리를 입은 열 살 남짓 오빠
anchor: a Korean boy of about ten in hemp clothes, his small sister beside him
palette: deep indigo, pale silver, hanji cream, deep green, warm amber

brother.label: 오빠
brother.desc: a Korean boy of about ten, short topknot, undyed hemp jeogori and trousers, straw shoes

sister.label: 여동생
sister.desc: a Korean girl of about six, twin braids, patched hemp dress, bare feet

tiger.label: 호랑이
tiger.desc: a huge orange tiger with bold black stripes and heavy paws, minhwa folk-painting style

hut.label: 산속 오두막
hut.desc: a small thatched hut on a dark mountainside, one paper window glowing

big_tree.label: 우물가 큰 나무
big_tree.desc: a huge old tree beside a round stone well, moonlit clearing

beats.visual: a young boy and his little sister at a hut door looking down a dusk mountain path
beats.motion: their eyes follow the path steadily downhill

beats.beat: 문밖에서 낯선 목소리가 어머니 흉내를 낸다.
beats.visual: a huge striped tiger crouched at a hut door, one paw raised to the wood
beats.motion: its paw rests steadily against the door

beats.visual: two children peering through a door crack, eyes wide in lamplight
beats.motion: their eyes widen steadily at the crack

beats.visual: a boy pulling his sister by the hand out a back door into moonlit brush
beats.motion: they run steadily into the brush

beats.visual: two children climbing the trunk of a huge tree beside a stone well, moonlight
beats.motion: they climb steadily up the trunk

beats.visual: a striped tiger circling the base of a huge tree, head craned upward
a tiger sliding back down a glistening tree trunk, claws leaving long marks
beats.motion: it slides steadily back down the trunk

beats.visual: a tiger hauling itself up a tree trunk notch by notch, children high above
two children at the top of a tree with hands pressed together toward the night sky
beats.motion: their joined hands lift steadily skyward

beats.visual: a thick golden rope descending from clouds toward a treetop where children wait
beats.motion: the rope lowers steadily through the clouds

beats.visual: two children climbing a golden rope high above dark mountains, clouds near
beats.motion: they rise steadily along the rope

beats.visual: a tiger gripping a frayed rope over dark ridges, strands beginning to part
beats.motion: the strands part steadily under its weight

beats.visual: two children on moonlit clouds looking down through a gap at dark mountains
a stone well and a huge tree at dawn, a long rope shadow fading on the ground
beats.motion: the shadow fades steadily in the growing light

withheld: 하늘에 남은 두 아이의 정체와, 썩은 동아줄을 잡은 짐승의 마지막
